nodes.label: VOLT — creatief bureau template
nodes.rationale: Grafisch-tier agency template (lime x purple x black, Syne + Space Mono). Archetype J: poster/asymmetric-diagonal neo-brutalism — rotated ticker marquee, tilted poster hero block with wobbling sticker, asymmetric rotated service collage, diagonal stats band, rotated contact form. All rotations reset under prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Neo-brutalist poster/diagonal design language (Archetype J)
nodes.rationale: Design system: hard 3px black borders, offset hard shadows (6px/10px 0 solid), blocks deliberately rotated 1-3.5deg to break the grid, uneven grid spans, marquee ticker rotated -2.2deg and scaled to bleed off-canvas, hover states that translate against the shadow for a 'pressed' feel. Motion and rotation are disabled wholesale via prefers-reduced-motion overrides.
